params.caption: 🎮 Bandai Namco is closing Unknown 9 studio Reflector Entertainment Two years after Unknown 9: Awakening flopped, Bandai Namco is shutting down the team behind it. Reflector had a new game in pre-production, but the publisher decided it was not worth the time or money to continue. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 22:55 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #BandaiNamco #GameIndustry #GamingNews
